name: application-keyboard-focus-ring-demo
title: Keyboard Focus Ring Demo
description: An accessibility showcase pairing common interactive controls with numbered tab-order badges and a visible keyboard focus ring, for documenting focus-order and focus-visible behavior.
useWhen: Documenting or testing a form/toolbar's keyboard tab order for accessibility review.
Teaching or demonstrating the difference between a focus-visible keyboard ring and default browser/mouse focus behavior.
avoidWhen: This is a documentation/demo pattern, not a reusable interactive control — don't ship the numbered badges in production UI.
You just need a real focus ring style on a component — apply the ring utility classes directly rather than reaching for this demo shell.
responsiveBehavior: Controls wrap via flex-wrap at narrow widths; the numbered badges stay anchored to each control's top-left corner regardless of wrap position.
accessibility: The focus ring shown uses `outline`, which (unlike `box-shadow`-only rings) is not clipped by `overflow: hidden` ancestors and remains visible against any background.
Numbered tab-order badges are purely illustrative; the real accessible tab order is still driven by DOM order and tabindex, not by the badge numbers.
The explanatory note clarifies that the ring is a focus-visible (keyboard) indicator, not shown for mouse-initiated focus, which is the correct default browser behavior to preserve.

variants.title: Tab order showcase
variants.description: A button, link, checkbox, and text input, each numbered 1–4 for tab order, with a visible blue focus ring shown on the first control and an explanatory note.
accessibility: Demonstrates outline-based focus rings, which stay visible even inside overflow-hidden containers.

variants.title: Tab order showcase (Dark)
variants.description: Keyboard focus ring demo adapted for dark surfaces, including the focus ring color re-tuned for dark contrast.
accessibility: The focus ring, badges, and note text all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
